name: Astral-Antiphon
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a tidally locked hemisphere, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in carbon here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
